item.title: Biblical Worldview: Seeing Life Through the Truth of God’s Word
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains what it means to have a biblical worldview and how Scripture shapes our thinking, living, and engagement with culture.

item.title: If the Lord Had Not Been on Our Side (Psalm 124)
item.description: In this episode of Walking Through the Psalms, Dave Jenkins teaches Psalm 124, calling believers to remember God’s deliverance, guard against pride, and anchor their hope in Christ.

item.title: New Age’s False Peace and the True Rest Found in Jesus Christ
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue explains why New Age spirituality often appeals to women seeking peace and healing, how these practices offer counterfeit comfort, and why true rest is found only through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ.

item.title: Job Overview, When the Righteous Suffer, The Sovereign Wisdom of God
item.description: A biblical overview of Job exploring God’s wisdom and sovereignty in suffering. Learn why the righteous suffer and how Job points us to Christ.

item.title: The Final Authority of God’s Word
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains why Scripture must be the final authority for faith and life, affirming the doctrine of Sola Scriptura and the sufficiency of God’s Word.

item.title: How Deception Spreads in the Church Today
item.description: Deception in the church rarely begins with outright denial of Christ. More often, it enters subtly through shifts in authority, emotional appeals, selective use of Scripture, and the quiet redefinition of biblical truth.
